phenomena.claim: Mean heat dissipated in single-bit erasure approaches the Landauer bound k_B T ln 2
phenomena.source: Berut, Arakelyan, Petrosyan, Ciliberto, Dillenschneider & Lutz, 'Experimental verification of Landauer's principle linking information and thermodynamics', Nature 483, 187-189 (2012) -- record verified 2026-09-23
phenomena.caveat: single overdamped colloidal particle in a modulated double-well; the MEAN dissipated heat saturates the bound only in the long-erasure-cycle (quasistatic) limit; individual realizations fluctuate below it; this tests average dissipation in one system class, not the principle's generality (see open_problems)

phenomena.claim: Information-to-energy conversion by measurement + feedback (Szilard-type engine) realized; generalized Jarzynski equality validated
phenomena.source: Toyabe, Sagawa, Ueda, Muneyuki & Sano, Nature Physics 6, 988-992 (2010), arXiv:1009.5287 (arXiv title 'Information heat engine: converting information to energy by feedback control') -- abstract-verified 2026-09-23
phenomena.caveat: Brownian particle on a spiral-staircase potential; free-energy gain exceeds work input only when the demon's own measurement/erasure cost is bookkept separately, exactly as the Sagawa-Ueda framework requires

phenomena.claim: Below-threshold quantum error correction: logical error rate is suppressed exponentially as surface-code distance grows
phenomena.source: Google Quantum AI (Acharya et al., 249 authors), 'Quantum error correction below the surface code threshold', Nature 638, 920-926 (2025), arXiv:2408.13687 -- abstract-verified 2026-09-23 (Lambda = 2.14 +/- 0.02 confirmed in abstract); archive: RAI_STRUCTURAL_THEORY_SEARCH Answer 1 lists this among the PREDICTION-grade confirmations that preceded measurement and could have failed; archive verification-order correction applied: '105 qubits is the processor; the distance-7 code is 101 qubits'
phenomena.caveat: one platform (superconducting, surface code); logical error 0.143% +/- 0.003% per cycle at distance 7; correlated error bursts approximately once per 3e9 cycles sit outside the exponential-suppression model

formalism.claim: Shannon entropy H = -sum p_i log p_i quantifies information of a source; source-coding and noisy-channel-coding theorems give it operational meaning (compression rate; channel capacity)
formalism.source: Shannon, 'A Mathematical Theory of Communication', Bell System Technical Journal 27, 379-423 (July) and 623-656 (October) (1948) -- bibliographic record verified 2026-09-23; the paper also introduces the term 'bit'
formalism.caveat: entropy is defined relative to a supplied probability distribution (see primitives)

formalism.claim: Von Neumann entropy S = -Tr(rho ln rho) is the quantum entropy of a density operator
formalism.source: von Neumann, Mathematische Grundlagen der Quantenmechanik (Springer, 1932); Engl. transl. Mathematical Foundations of Quantum Mechanics (Princeton, 1955) -- bibliographic record verified 2026-09-23 (density matrices and this entropy introduced there)
formalism.caveat: predates Shannon and is thermodynamic in origin; its operational information-theoretic meaning was supplied later (Schumacher 1995, see derived_objects)

formalism.claim: No-cloning theorem: no unitary process copies an arbitrary unknown quantum state
formalism.source: Wootters & Zurek, 'A single quantum cannot be cloned', Nature 299, 802-803 (1982) -- record verified 2026-09-23; independent companion result Dieks, Phys. Lett. A 92, 271 (1982) cited but not independently fetched
formalism.caveat: follows from linearity; optimal approximate and probabilistic cloning bounds are later refinements

formalism.claim: Holevo bound: the accessible classical information from an ensemble of quantum states is bounded by the Holevo quantity chi
formalism.source: Holevo, 'Bounds for the Quantity of Information Transmitted by a Quantum Communication Channel', Probl. Peredachi Inf. 9:3, 3-11 (1973); Engl. transl. Problems Inform. Transmission 9, 177-183 (1973) -- Mathnet bibliographic record verified 2026-09-23

formalism.claim: Fault-tolerance threshold theorem: quantum computation of arbitrary length is possible if the physical error rate is below a constant threshold
formalism.source: Aharonov & Ben-Or, 'Fault-Tolerant Quantum Computation With Constant Error Rate', quant-ph/9906129 (SIAM J. Comput. version; extends STOC 1997, quant-ph/9611025) -- abstract-verified 2026-09-23; independent routes (Kitaev; Knill-Laflamme-Zurek) not independently fetched
formalism.caveat: threshold value is model-dependent (noise locality and Markovianity assumptions); the theorem is the theory side of the OBSERVED below-threshold entry in phenomena

primitives.claim: Information measures are defined over a supplied state space (probability distributions classically; density operators quantum-mechanically) -- information theory does not itself supply the probabilistic or Hilbert-space structure
primitives.source: textbook-standard (Shannon 1948 defines H over given distributions); consistent with archive REALITY_PICTURE_01 LEVEL 1: a probabilistic outcome structure is forced as description, its origin is not
primitives.caveat: this is exactly the joint the reconstruction programs in alternative_formulations attempt to invert

derived_objects.claim: Schumacher compression: von Neumann entropy is the optimal asymptotic qubit rate for faithful compression of a quantum source -- the operational meaning of S
derived_objects.source: Schumacher, 'Quantum coding', Phys. Rev. A 51, 2738-2747 (1995) -- record verified 2026-09-23; the paper also coins 'qubit' in print

derived_objects.claim: HSW theorem: the classical capacity of a quantum channel attains the Holevo quantity chi (product-state coding)
derived_objects.source: Holevo, 'The Capacity of Quantum Channel with General Signal States', IEEE Trans. Inf. Theory 44, 269-273 (1998), quant-ph/9611023 -- abstract-verified 2026-09-23 (abstract states it completes the Hausladen-Jozsa-Schumacher-Westmoreland-Wootters pure-state result); Schumacher & Westmoreland, Phys. Rev. A 56, 131 (1997) cited but not independently fetched
derived_objects.caveat: the single-letter formula fails in general for entangled inputs -- see open_problems (Hastings non-additivity)

empirical_inputs.claim: Information theory proper imports no empirical constants; physical instantiation imports them -- temperature via k_B T for erasure cost, hardware error rate p (against threshold p_th) for error correction
empirical_inputs.source: Landauer, 'Irreversibility and heat generation in the computing process', IBM J. Res. Dev. 5, 183 (1961) supplies the k_B T ln 2 bridge -- record verified 2026-09-23

constants.claim: The domain introduces no new fundamental constant; the Landauer cost per bit, k_B T ln 2, is fixed by k_B = 1.380649e-23 J/K, exact since the 2019 SI redefinition
constants.source: Landauer 1961 (record verified 2026-09-23); k_B exactness: 2019 SI redefinition (26th CGPM Resolution 1), standard
constants.caveat: the factor ln 2 is conventional (bit vs nat); T is a state variable, not a constant

symmetries.claim: Von Neumann entropy is invariant under unitaries; strong subadditivity S(ABC) + S(B) <= S(AB) + S(BC) holds and is equivalent to data-processing monotonicity of quantum relative entropy under CPTP maps
symmetries.source: Lieb & Ruskai, 'Proof of the strong subadditivity of quantum-mechanical entropy', J. Math. Phys. 14, 1938-1941 (1973) -- record verified 2026-09-23
symmetries.caveat: recorded under symmetries as a structural invariance/monotonicity property, not a group symmetry; the monotonicity equivalence is the later standard development (Lindblad/Uhlmann, not independently fetched)

limits.claim: Classical Shannon theory is recovered from quantum information theory on commuting (simultaneously diagonalizable) states; von Neumann entropy reduces to the Shannon entropy of the eigenvalues
limits.source: textbook-standard (Nielsen & Chuang, Quantum Computation and Quantum Information, Cambridge 2000)

known_connections.claim: Information connects to thermodynamics at the effective layer: erasure carries a minimal entropy cost (Landauer) and measurement information is convertible to work under feedback (Szilard/Sagawa-Ueda), both realized experimentally
known_connections.source: Landauer 1961; Berut et al. 2012; Toyabe et al. 2010 (all verified above); archive edge: 'thermodynamics --EMERGES_FROM--> coarse-graining [T] CLOSED at effective layer' (REALITY_PICTURE_01 LEVEL 3)
known_connections.caveat: the generality of the information-theoretic exorcism of Maxwell's demon is contested in the foundations literature -- see open_problems

known_connections.claim: Holographic/informational structure: AdS/CFT is the only CLOSED observable-mapping arrow on the archive record; generalization to our cosmology UNRESOLVED
known_connections.source: archive ref: program/REALITY_PICTURE_01.md LEVEL 4 item 3 [E] -- wording checked against origin/v4 by adversarial verifier 2026-09-23
known_connections.caveat: in-house audit summary (the program's own unreviewed assessment of which correspondence arrows are CLOSED on its record), not a community-derived result -- reclassified from COMMUNITY-DERIVED by the adversarial verifier; edge carries the REALITY_PICTURE_01 vocabulary pending Stage-3 seven-class typing

known_connections.claim: Within AdS/CFT, entanglement entropy of a boundary region equals the area of a bulk minimal surface (Ryu-Takayanagi); generic 'geometry from entanglement' is hypothesis-grade
known_connections.source: Ryu & Takayanagi, 'Holographic Derivation of Entanglement Entropy from AdS/CFT', Phys. Rev. Lett. 96, 181602 (2006), hep-th/0603001 -- abstract-verified 2026-09-23; archive: REALITY_PICTURE_01 LEVEL 4 item 4 'Geometric emergence from entanglement -- suggestive, not derived generically [H]'
known_connections.caveat: the derived statement is scoped to AdS/CFT; the extrapolation beyond it is [H] and firewalled from the derived part

known_disconnects.claim: Entanglement does NOT enable superluminal signaling
known_disconnects.source: archive: REALITY_PICTURE_01 LEVEL 0 item 3 'Entanglement + Bell violations (no superluminal signaling)' [E]; theory side: no-communication theorem, textbook-standard
known_disconnects.caveat: observational side rests on the Bell-test record; theorem side is COMMUNITY-DERIVED

known_disconnects.claim: Information-theoretic reconstructions do NOT establish that information is ontologically fundamental: the verified reconstructions recover the finite-dimensional quantum formalism from operational axioms; none derives spacetime, dynamics, or SM content from information alone
known_disconnects.source: scope read off the three fetched reconstruction abstracts (Hardy quant-ph/0101012; Chiribella-D'Ariano-Perinotti PRA 84, 012311; Clifton-Bub-Halvorson Found. Phys. 33, 1561), all abstract-verified 2026-09-23; owner firewall for this record
known_disconnects.caveat: 'it from bit' (Wheeler, 'Information, physics, quantum: the search for links', in Zurek ed., Complexity, Entropy and the Physics of Information, Addison-Wesley 1990 -- bibliographic record verified 2026-09-23) is recorded as HYPOTHESIS, not result

known_disconnects.claim: The below-threshold QEC demonstration does NOT yet demonstrate scalable fault-tolerant computation
known_disconnects.source: gap read off the Nature 638, 920 (2025) abstract itself: correlated error events approximately once per 3e9 cycles; a single distance-7 code patch; real-time decoding demonstrated at distance 5 (63 microsecond latency)
known_disconnects.caveat: the distance between demonstrated logical error rates (~1.4e-3/cycle) and algorithmically relevant ones (~1e-10) is recorded, not bridged

open_problems.claim: Additivity failure: the Holevo capacity is non-additive under tensor products (entangled inputs can help), so no closed single-letter formula is known for the classical or quantum capacity of a general channel
open_problems.source: Hastings, 'Superadditivity of communication capacity using entangled inputs', Nature Physics 5, 255 (2009), arXiv:0809.3972 -- abstract-verified 2026-09-23 (random counterexample to the additivity conjecture)
open_problems.caveat: existence proof by random construction, not an explicit channel

open_problems.claim: The foundational status of Landauer's principle is contested: Norton argues standard derivations are question-begging and neglect thermal fluctuations; Ladyman et al. defend the principle
open_problems.source: Norton, 'Waiting for Landauer', Stud. Hist. Philos. Mod. Phys. 42, 184-198 (2011) -- record verified 2026-09-23; reply 'Landauer Defended: Reply to Norton' (Ladyman & Robertson) located but not independently fetched
open_problems.caveat: the OBSERVED entry (Berut 2012) tests mean dissipation in one system class and does not adjudicate this generality dispute; the dispute itself, not its resolution, is what this record banks

open_problems.claim: No extension of the informational reconstruction theorems beyond finite-dimensional operational theories (to QFT, gravity, or cosmology) is on record
open_problems.source: scope limitation read off the fetched reconstruction abstracts (Hardy; CDP; CBH), 2026-09-23

open_problems.claim: The gravity-information interface is open: black-hole information and the origin of holography in our cosmology are unresolved
open_problems.source: archive: REALITY_PICTURE_01 'gravity --?--> entropy (holography hints) [H] suggestive, not derived generically' + LEVEL 6 item 3 (gravity-quantum interface)

observables.claim: QEC error-suppression factor Lambda = 2.14 +/- 0.02 (distance 5 -> 7); logical error per cycle 0.143% +/- 0.003% at distance 7; logical qubit lifetime 2.4 +/- 0.3 times the best physical qubit
observables.source: Google Quantum AI, Nature 638, 920-926 (2025), arXiv:2408.13687 -- abstract-verified 2026-09-23; archive grading: PREDICTION in the QEC sector (RAI_STRUCTURAL_THEORY_SEARCH Answer 1, Section IX depth table)
observables.caveat: Lambda is a hardware figure of merit, not a constant of nature; the PREDICTION label attaches to the exponential-suppression form below threshold (threshold theorem), whose confirmation preceded measurement and could have failed -- the numerical value is platform-specific

alternative_formulations.claim: ALTERNATIVE-FORMULATION: quantum theory derived from five operational axioms; the continuous-reversibility axiom separates quantum from classical probability
alternative_formulations.source: Hardy, 'Quantum Theory From Five Reasonable Axioms', quant-ph/0101012 (2001) -- abstract-verified 2026-09-23
alternative_formulations.caveat: finite-dimensional operational reconstruction; recovers the formalism, not the physical content (see known_disconnects)

alternative_formulations.claim: ALTERNATIVE-FORMULATION: informational derivation of quantum theory from six operational principles, with purification as the separating postulate
alternative_formulations.source: Chiribella, D'Ariano & Perinotti, 'Informational derivation of Quantum Theory', Phys. Rev. A 84, 012311 (2011), arXiv:1011.6451 -- abstract-verified 2026-09-23

alternative_formulations.claim: ALTERNATIVE-FORMULATION: quantum theory characterized by three information-theoretic impossibilities (no superluminal information transfer by measurement, no broadcasting, no unconditionally secure bit commitment)
alternative_formulations.source: Clifton, Bub & Halvorson, 'Characterizing quantum theory in terms of information-theoretic constraints', Found. Phys. 33, 1561-1591 (2003), quant-ph/0211089 -- abstract-verified 2026-09-23
alternative_formulations.caveat: proved within a C*-algebraic framework; the C*-assumption itself carries substantial structure (recorded limitation in the subsequent literature), so this is weaker as a reconstruction than Hardy/CDP

domain_of_validity.claim: Classical information theory applies wherever probability assignments are licensed; quantum-information results are experimentally verified in engineered few- to ~100-qubit systems; Landauer-scale thermodynamics is verified in single-bit overdamped colloidal (and nanomagnetic) systems; the reconstruction theorems are scoped to finite-dimensional operational theories
domain_of_validity.source: boundary assembled from the verified entries above (Berut 2012; Toyabe 2010; Google Quantum AI 2025; Hardy/CDP/CBH scopes)
domain_of_validity.caveat: no verified extension of the informational reconstructions to QFT, gravity, or cosmology (see open_problems)
